news.title: 유가·환율 리스크 부각
news.title_en: Oil Price & FX Risks in Focus
news.summary: 디젤 10.68페소 인상(중동發), 6월 국제수지 흑자 34억달러로 대외 완충 개선
news.summary_en: Diesel up ₱10.68 (Middle East-driven); June balance of payments surplus of $3.4B improves external buffers
news.body: 중동발 유가 쇼크로 **디젤 리터당 10.68페소** 인상(3일 분산)돼 물류비·실질구매력 부담 확대. 한편 **6월 국제수지 흑자 34억달러**(2년래 최대)로 대외 완충은 개선됐으나, BSP는 연말 BoP 적자 확대를 전망해 하반기 환율 변동성 여지.
news.body_en: A Middle East-driven oil shock pushed **diesel up ₱10.68 per liter** (staggered over 3 days), adding to logistics costs and eroding real purchasing power. Meanwhile, the **June balance of payments surplus of $3.4B** (a 2-year high) improved external buffers, but the BSP projects a wider year-end BoP deficit, leaving room for FX volatility in the second half.
news.insight: 연료비 전가에 따른 대형가전 구매 지연·가격민감도, 페소 표시 수입원가·부품 조달비 영향 주시 권고.
news.insight_en: Watch for delayed big-ticket appliance purchases and heightened price sensitivity from fuel-cost pass-through, along with the impact on peso-denominated import costs and component sourcing.

competitor-ads.title: 성수기 TV·에어컨 경쟁 집중
competitor-ads.title_en: Peak-Season Competition Concentrated in TV & AC
competitor-ads.summary: Samsung 가격딜·TCL 신모델 무이자·Hisense 월드컵 브랜딩
competitor-ads.summary_en: Samsung price deals · TCL new-model interest-free financing · Hisense World Cup branding
competitor-ads.body: 성수기 진입과 함께 경쟁사 광고가 **TV·에어컨**에 집중되는 흐름. **Samsung**은 비전 AI TV를 대형 할인+사운드바로 **가격 공세**, **TCL**은 인버터 에어컨 신모델을 무이자 할부로 밀며 **신제품+금융** 카드, **Hisense**는 월드컵 스폰서십으로 **브랜딩** 상향 시도.
competitor-ads.body_en: As peak season begins, competitor advertising is concentrating on **TV & AC**. **Samsung** is running a **price offensive** on its Vision AI TV with deep discounts plus a soundbar, **TCL** is pushing a new inverter AC model on interest-free installments as a **new-product + financing** play, and **Hisense** is attempting to lift its **branding** through World Cup sponsorship.
competitor-ads.insight: TV 성수기 프로모 강도·번들 점검, 에어컨 할부조건 경쟁력 확인, 중가 브랜드 상향 시도 주시.
competitor-ads.insight_en: Review TV peak-season promo intensity and bundles, verify the competitiveness of AC installment terms, and watch mid-price brands attempting to move upmarket.

fx.title: 페소 약세 심화
fx.summary: 월말 ₱/USD 61.3·일별 61.7 사상최저 근접(5년 전 50.0), 동남아 6개국 중 최대 낙폭 · NEER 88.7 하락하나 REER 98.1 유지(물가가 명목약세 상쇄)
fx.summary_en: Month-end ₱/USD 61.3, daily 61.7 near a record low (50.0 five years ago), the largest drop among six Southeast Asian currencies; NEER fell to 88.7 but REER held at 98.1 (inflation offsets nominal weakness)
fx.body: 페소는 대달러 **월말 ₱/USD 61.3**(일별로는 **61.7 사상최저** 근접)으로 5년 전(50.0) 대비 크게 약세이고, 동남아 6개국을 대미달러로 지수화하면 **페소 낙폭이 가장 큽니다**. BIS 명목실효환율(NEER)도 96.8→88.7로 하락. 다만 실질실효환율(REER)은 **98.1로 거의 유지** — 필리핀 물가가 교역상대국보다 빨리 올라 명목 약세를 상쇄했기 때문입니다.
fx.body_en: The peso weakened sharply against the dollar to a **month-end ₱/USD 61.3** (approaching a **record-low 61.7** on a daily basis) versus 50.0 five years ago, and when the six Southeast Asian currencies are indexed against the US dollar, **the peso shows the largest decline**. The BIS nominal effective exchange rate (NEER) also fell from 96.8 to 88.7. However, the real effective exchange rate (REER) is **nearly unchanged at 98.1** — because Philippine inflation has risen faster than that of its trading partners, offsetting the nominal weakness.
fx.insight: **NEER↓ = 원가 압박**(조달통화 대비 페소 약세로 수입 가전 COGS 상방), **REER 유지 = 실질 구매력 정체**(대형·프리미엄 수요 부담). 위안 강세(대페소 +17%)로 중국 조달 방어가 1순위.
fx.insight_en: **NEER↓ = cost pressure** (peso weakness against sourcing currencies pushes up imported-appliance COGS); **REER holding = stagnant real purchasing power** (a drag on big-ticket and premium demand). With the yuan strong (+17% vs. the peso), defending China-based sourcing is the top priority.
